task_instance: Acting as the SurrealDB knowledge skill, answer an implementation request: define a schemafull `user` table with record-access signup/signin that hashes passwords with Argon2, a unique email index, email-format assertion, and per-record deny-by-default permissions, plus the matching SDK connect/signup/signin flow with bound parameters -- all grounded in the skill's local reference fragments.
evidence: This is a documentation/reference skill; its core deliverable is producing correct, safe SurrealQL and SDK guidance from the bundled fragments in references/, which does not require running a server. Read SKILL.md and the fragments 03-modeling-security.md (record access, Argon2, unique index, explicit permissions), 02-surrealql.md (DEFINE ACCESS grammar with DURATION FOR TOKEN/SESSION) and 04-sdks.md (connect/use/signin order, variable binding). Produced auth_schema.surql (DEFINE TABLE user SCHEMAFULL with PERMISSIONS keyed to $auth.id; DEFINE FIELD email ASSERT string::is_email; DEFINE INDEX ... FIELDS email UNIQUE; DEFINE ACCESS ... TYPE RECORD with SIGNUP crypto::argon2::generate / SIGNIN crypto::argon2::compare / DURATION FOR TOKEN 15m, FOR SESSION 12h) and client_signin.ts (new Surreal -> connect -> signup/signin with a bound variables object, no string interpolation). Verified by cross-checking every construct against the intact fragments (grep confirmed DEFINE TABLE user SCHEMAFULL, crypto::argon2::generate, crypto::argon2::compare, FIELDS email UNIQUE, TYPE RECORD, string::is_email all appear there), confirming the statement shape against the DEFINE ACCESS grammar block in 02-surrealql.md, and a python paren/statement lint (6 parens balanced, 6 terminated statements). The skill's safe patterns (parameter binding, password hashing, deny-by-default record permissions, unique index for unique fields) are all honored. Note: the surreal binary is not installed in this offline runtime, so the SurrealQL was not executed against a live engine; execution is not part of this reference skill's deliverable and the output was verified against the skill's own authoritative fragments instead. Files: auth_schema.surql, client_signin.ts, result.json in the work directory.
